build_commands: apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git curl ca-certificates build-essential protobuf-compiler libprotobuf-dev libtss2-dev libssl-dev pkg-config cmake clang llvm
notes: Dockerfile.final uses rust:slim base image. System packages installed via apt-get. repo_setup.sh clones the confidential-containers/trustee repository at the specified commit. setup_runtime.sh installs Rust toolchain via rustup. Hidden tests and eval.sh are NOT baked into the image - they are mounted at runtime for verification.
